name: 43026 · Hilliard, OH
findings: ZIP 43026 (Hilliard) has 190 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43026 (Hilliard) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
